observed_result: 29 phenylpropanoid-pathway orthologs identified; many flavonoid genes show 2.6-500x higher expression in flowers than leaves; strong tissue-specific flavonoid profiles
what_it_establishes: C. japonicum has recoverable flavonoid/phenylpropanoid machinery and strong floral tissue specificity
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not identify the causal W/C switch in focal taxa or historical transition direction
EAzami_problem: Mechanism can be framed as regulatory/structural reuse rather than mere pathway presence

observed_result: 350 nuclear loci; dominant Japanese radiation includes 36/38 sampled Japanese species; C. lineare and C. dipsacolepis have separate histories; some discordance attributed to hybridization/ILS
what_it_establishes: One dominant Japanese radiation plus exceptional lineages and a broad biogeographic time frame
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not independently replicate each exceptional dispersal event or identify colour mechanism
EAzami_problem: Colonization success is strongly asymmetric rather than many equivalent entries

observed_result: Japanese and Taiwanese Nipponocirsium clades; prevalent tetraploidy with chromosome-number differences; C. pengii diploid; recent divergence
what_it_establishes: Chromosome evolution and young lineage divergence accompany East Asian diversification
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not show that ploidy caused the focal flower-colour transitions
EAzami_problem: Ploidy/genome change is a candidate macro covariate rather than a colour-causation claim

observed_result: Three monophyletic subsections diverged ca. 1.30-1.02 Ma; independent 2C shifts; island fragmentation/demographic history; var. takaoense floral-colour polymorphism linked experimentally to anthocyanin expression and pollinator preference
what_it_establishes: Young Quaternary island lineages combine genomic, demographic and floral variation
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not by itself establish ancestral white/coloured direction or a shared causal molecular change across white lineages
EAzami_problem: Recent radiation supplies a natural replicated scale for testing reversible trait evolution

observed_result: 36/38=94.74% in dominant radiation; C. lineare exception supported in 3/3 analyses and 2/2 independent high-dimensional data-generation groups; C. dipsacolepis supported by 1 group; Arenicola extra colonization unsupported
what_it_establishes: Strict all-Japan single origin is rejected; best current structure is dominant radiation plus rare secondary histories
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not yet provide a completed independent 294/296 empirical tree or replicate C. dipsacolepis in a second data-generation group
EAzami_problem: Why did one entry radiate massively while secondary entries did not?

observed_result: 945 rooted six-tip topologies; published topology minimum 1 loss + 1 regain; no-regain penalty +2; 270/945 require regain and 675/945 permit no-regain; BP monophyly 36/45 requires regain; W monophyly 0/45 requires regain
what_it_establishes: Regain support is locally robust around the published topology but globally topology-sensitive
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not give posterior topology probabilities or prove molecular reactivation
EAzami_problem: Historical colour direction is an identifiability problem that must propagate topology uncertainty

observed_result: Collapsing polymorphic var. takaoense to one ambiguous species tip reduces the minimum transition count relative to representing W and C samples separately
what_it_establishes: Species-tip state aggregation can erase recent transitions
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not quantify the bias across the full genus until repeated on multiple polymorphic systems and tree ensembles
EAzami_problem: One-state-per-species macroevolutionary matrices may underestimate transition rates in young radiations

observed_result: Cross-paper reuse and a public-read pseudoreplicate were detected; current accepted baseline is 294 biological tips / 295 SRRs rather than earlier 302/303 arithmetic
what_it_establishes: Evidence independence must be counted by biological sample/data-generation group rather than paper/accession count
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not itself change biological topology
EAzami_problem: Naive literature vote-counting can inflate apparent replication

observed_result: Source-backed W/C/P states occur in multiple nuclear contexts including Arenicola, Sinocirsium and Nipponocirsium, with W/C polymorphism within var. takaoense and documented Japanese polymorphic systems
what_it_establishes: White phenotype and W/C polymorphism recur across separated East Asian lineages
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not prove identical molecular mechanism or exact number/direction of transitions without the full topology ensemble
EAzami_problem: Macro phenotypic recurrence needs pathway-level rather than single-gene convergence tests

observed_result: 216 taxa / 3725 observations / 6626 heads; across nine endpoints at least about half of visible image variance remains below assigned-species means under one-head-per-photo and balanced-10-photo sensitivities; precision-aware variation-vs-climate-association rho=-0.0569 and hierarchical variance-meta-regression b=-0.0416 with CI spanning zero
what_it_establishes: Species means compress large visible within-assigned-species heterogeneity, and visible dispersion is not a single common axis with within-species spatial climatic association across modules
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not establish genetic variance, phenotypic plasticity, local adaptation, evolutionary rate or a resolved Cirsium tree
EAzami_problem: Micro/population variation and macro species-level ecological/evolutionary summaries may be partially decoupled and require hierarchical scale-explicit models

observed_result: State compression in 4/4 reviewed polymorphic systems; only takaoense currently has morph-linked nuclear samples; its minimum transition count changes 1->2; replicated transition-rate test currently 0/4 testable
what_it_establishes: HMM2 has partial support at state-resolution level and direct minimum-count support in the only currently testable morph-linked system
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not show transition rates are doubled or that four polymorphic taxa represent four independent evolutionary transitions
EAzami_problem: Morph-genotype linkage rather than species presence alone is a major macroevolutionary information bottleneck

observed_result: 17-family audit: entry+core+branch 9/9 directly covered; anthocyanin+regulatory+transport 1/8; terminal anthocyanin+MBW+transport 0/7 in named targeted published panels
what_it_establishes: Published molecular coverage is much denser upstream than at the terminal/regulatory/transport layer most diagnostic of reversible W/C switching
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not mean terminal/regulatory genes are absent from Cirsium genomes or transcriptomes
EAzami_problem: Targeted-panel reporting resolution can lag behind the molecular layer needed for evolutionary mechanism tests

observed_result: 31,263 protein headers and 554,761 GFF records scanned; 0 functional-text hits for all 13 searched families including CHS/FLS/DFR controls; distributed files expose structural IDs/coordinates rather than functional labels
what_it_establishes: Public C. nipponicum sequence data exist but FASTA/GFF functional labels cannot recover even positive-control pathway genes
what_it_does_not_establish: Does not imply any searched family is absent from the genome
EAzami_problem: Functional annotation linkage is a separate information layer from having genome sequence

observed_result: Reviewed UniProt queries recover candidate homologs for 11/11 tested families from the same C. nipponicum proteome; DFR top=Cn_g13756.t1 71.1% identity and ANS top=Cn_g8152.t1 74.6%; large UGT/MYB/bHLH/WD40/GST/MATE families remain orthology-ambiguous
what_it_establishes: The apparent annotation/reporting gap does not prevent sequence-level recovery of terminal/regulatory/transport family candidates; DFR/ANS provide strong next phylogenetic/domain targets
what_it_does_not_establish: BLAST top hits do not prove one-to-one orthology, anthocyanin function, pathway activity, or a white-flower mechanism
EAzami_problem: Micro-to-macro inference requires an explicit resolution ladder from reported panel -> functional annotation -> sequence homology -> orthology/function -> colour-lineage comparison
